explanation: Magazine covers and other adverts showed Santa in red decades before Haddon Sundblom began painting him for Coca-Cola in 1931. Those paintings did help fix his jolly, grandfatherly look.

claims.text: Santa Claus was shown in a red suit well before Coca-Cola's Santa advertisements began in 1931.
Haddon Sundblom painted Santa Claus for Coca-Cola advertisements from 1931.
Magazine covers, including Puck's in the early 1900s, and other advertisers showed Santa in red before Coca-Cola did.
Sundblom's paintings helped popularize the image of a jolly, grandfatherly Santa.
